integrity: The exact identity has a self-contained proof, and two independent finite implementations reproduce it on 11,747 and 4,567 instances. Finite tests are not proof and no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: The formula applies to prefixes of a primitive periodic word after the sharp uniform length threshold. It does not extend as stated to arbitrary preperiodic texts or shorter prefixes. A special distinct-run complete-power case is already indexed, and prior exhaustive priority is not guaranteed.
title: A sharp stabilization threshold for minimal absent words of periodic prefixes
